La Vida Luka is a luxury guesthouse in Lukasrand, Pretoria, offering air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, private bathrooms and free WiFi. The guesthouse also provides free on-site parking, a practical detail for guests arriving with their own vehicle rather than relying on a shuttle or taxi.

Its location in eastern Pretoria puts guests within easy reach of several embassies, universities and hospitals in the area, making it a convenient base for business travellers, diplomatic visitors, students and anyone attending to medical appointments nearby. Based in Lukasrand, La Vida Luka suits visitors looking for a smaller, more personal guesthouse stay over a large hotel, particularly those needing to be close to Pretoria's diplomatic and academic district.

LJL Business Solutions is based in Centurion and Winkelspruit, offering a total business solution that spans branding, printing and graphic design through to hardware and software sales and IT support. On the IT side, the company covers onsite and remote support for company networks, servers and everyday computer issues, backed by what it describes as strong IT policies built on trust and industry-standard practice.

Its digital side covers SEO support, social media marketing, and building and hosting websites, giving clients both the online presence and the day-to-day technical support needed to run a small or growing business. Serving Brakfontein and the wider Centurion area, LJL Business Solutions suits businesses that want branding, printing, IT support and digital marketing handled by a single supplier rather than several separate ones.

Lotus Gardens Clinic is a public primary healthcare clinic on Bergamot Street in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, listed in the Medpages healthcare database as a public clinic serving the local community. As a public facility, it forms part of the area's primary healthcare network, offering the kind of day-to-day medical care residents would otherwise have to travel further to access.

The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm and on Sundays from 8am to 5pm, closed on Saturdays, giving residents access to primary care outside standard weekday office hours as well. Based in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, the clinic suits residents needing accessible, no-appointment-fee primary healthcare close to home.

LvA Consulting Services is an accounting and tax practice based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, providing tax and accounting support to individuals, companies and close corporations. Its services cover tax calculations and submissions for individuals, provisional tax and VAT calculations and submissions for companies and CCs, tax clearance requests, correction requests and SARS liaison on clients' behalf.

Beyond tax compliance, the practice also offers monthly accounting and payroll services, giving smaller businesses ongoing bookkeeping support rather than only once-off tax filing help. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, LvA Consulting Services suits individuals and small businesses that want their tax submissions, SARS correspondence and monthly books handled by one accounting practice rather than juggling several providers.

MCB Design, trading as Breazy, is a large-format digital printing business based in Riviera, Pretoria. The company prints on PVC, vinyl, polyester cloth and paper using Roland Ecosolvent inks and a six-colour CMYKLcLm printing process at up to 1440 dpi, producing photo-realistic, scratch-, water- and UV-resistant results without needing lamination.

Its product range covers retail banners, signage, exhibition graphics and interior and exterior graphics, along with branded gazebos, flags and rollup banners for events and advertising. The team also offers branding support for clients starting a project from scratch, working at competitive rates with short turnaround times. Based in Riviera, Pretoria, MCB Design/Breazy suits businesses needing exhibition, advertising or event-branding materials produced quickly and finished to a professional standard.

M3LST Manufacturing and Engineering is a Rosslyn-based turnkey manufacturing and engineering firm with a specific focus on manufacturing projects and engineering solutions for industry. Though a relatively young company, its owners bring a combined experience in manufacturing and engineering exceeding 40 years, and stay hands-on in daily operations from planning through to execution.

The business manufactures items including trolleys, cages, tyre stillages and pallets, working to national and international standards and recognised labour and manufacturing practices. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, M3LST suits industrial and automotive supply chain clients needing manufacturing and engineering work handled by a team that understands the customer brief in detail rather than working from a generic template.

Madanzo Construction & Projects, incorporated in 2012, is a building contractor and landscaping business based in the Hesteapark area of Pretoria. Its landscaping side covers garden design, lawn edging, tree felling and pruning, weed control, garden irrigation and paving, along with vegetable garden design and general plant and garden maintenance.

On the building side, the company takes on general construction work including house extensions and kitchen and bathroom renovations. Combining landscaping and building work under one company lets clients plan a garden redesign alongside a home renovation without coordinating two separate contractors. Based in Hesteapark, Pretoria, Madanzo Construction & Projects suits homeowners planning both outdoor landscaping and indoor renovation work on the same property.

Magda Lourens Properties is a local estate agency based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, established in 2002 under a different name. The agency specialises in residential property sales and rentals, working mainly across Pretoria East but also taking on business in the greater Pretoria area and Centurion.

Its team of agents handles sales, rentals and on-show viewings across a portfolio of residential properties and developments in the area. The agency is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, closed on weekends. Based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, Magda Lourens Properties suits buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants looking for an established, locally rooted estate agency rather than a larger national franchise.

Mankweng Tombstones Lotus is the Lotus Gardens branch of Mankweng Tombstones, a tombstone designer, manufacturer and installer with close to a decade of experience in the granite field. The business designs, manufactures and installs personalised tombstones using granite and other high-quality materials, aiming to produce a lasting memorial rather than a mass-produced marker.

Customers buying a tombstone through this branch get free engraving included with every purchase, and can spread the cost over a 12-month layby plan rather than paying the full amount upfront. The branch also offers nationwide delivery for customers outside the immediate area. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 2pm. Based in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, this branch suits families arranging a memorial who want affordable pricing without compromising on the quality of the finished piece.

Marie Stopes Pretoria is a sexual and reproductive healthcare clinic in the Pretoria CBD, part of the wider Marie Stopes South Africa network of safe abortion clinics. The clinic offers safe abortion and post-abortion care, a range of contraceptive options, and HIV and sexually transmitted infection testing and treatment.

Beyond these core services, the clinic also provides women's wellness consultations and pap smear screening, which can pick up early signs of cervical cancer as well as certain infections, and offers telemedicine consultations for clients who prefer a remote option. Based in Trevenna, in Pretoria's city centre, Marie Stopes Pretoria suits women and other clients across the city seeking confidential, specialist sexual and reproductive healthcare in one clinic.

MATEAC is a BBBEE Level 1, 100% Black-owned engineering and training consultancy based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria. The business specialises in electrical, automation and mining expertise, offering engineering services registered with the Electrical Conformance Board of South Africa and the Department of Labour.

As a registered electrical contractor, MATEAC places particular focus on employing and upskilling people from the local community, building technical capacity in the area rather than only completing projects with outside labour. Based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, the consultancy suits clients in the electrical, automation and mining sectors looking for a Black-owned engineering partner with a community-development focus alongside its technical work.

Maverick Generators has manufactured and supplied diesel generators from its Pumulani, Pretoria plant since 2007. The company builds units ranging from 30kVA up to 2200kVA, custom-made to each client's specific requirements, and uses established engine brands including Volvo-Penta, Perkins, Cummins, Lovol, Scania, FAW and John Deere.

Beyond manufacturing, Maverick Generators handles generator sales, installation, servicing and repairs, and builds custom automatic mains failure and synchronisation control panels and base load panels for industrial clients. The business is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 5pm and Friday from 7:30am to 3pm. Based in Pumulani, Pretoria, the company supplies generators and panels to industrial and commercial clients across South Africa and the wider African continent.

Maybery Attorneys Inc. is a commercial and property law firm based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, specialising in business law, commercial contracts and corporate matters. The firm's litigation practice covers corporate governance disputes, shareholder litigation, contractual disputes with clients and service providers, and specialised litigation aimed at holding company directors personally liable for company debts.

Alongside litigation, the firm handles property evictions, debt collections, partnership agreements, trusts, mergers and acquisitions, trademarks and retainer arrangements for ongoing legal support. Based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, Maybery Attorneys Inc. suits businesses needing holistic legal advice across contracts, operations, labour, cash flow, collections and compliance from a single commercial law firm.

Maymed Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, offering prescription dispensing and chronic medication management for regular patients. The pharmacy also provides blood pressure and glucose monitoring, vitamins and supplements, and first aid supplies for everyday health needs.

For preventative care, Maymed Pharmacy offers flu shots and other immunisations, and gives customers the choice of delivery or in-store pickup for their orders. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed on Sundays. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, the pharmacy suits residents looking for a neighbourhood pharmacy that combines everyday dispensing with basic health monitoring and immunisation services.

MCS Fire & Management Solutions has supplied fire protection equipment and safety products since 2016, based in Queenswood, Pretoria. The company supplies and services fire extinguishers, hose reels, fire hydrants and boosters, along with SABS-approved safety signage, fire blankets, smoke detectors and sprinkler systems.

Its technicians are SAQCC Fire registered and carry official ID cards, and the company runs fully equipped service vehicles for on-site maintenance, with loan units available while equipment is removed for testing or repair and turnaround typically within 48 hours. Beyond equipment supply and servicing, MCS also offers fire risk assessments, consulting and safety training. Based in Moregloed, Pretoria, the company suits businesses needing certified, SABS-compliant fire safety equipment and ongoing servicing rather than a once-off equipment purchase.

Megalight Electrical Wholesalers supplies cables, lighting, switchgear and renewable energy solutions such as solar panels and inverters from its base in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria. Operating since 2013, the company draws on more than 63 years of combined expertise among its team to serve contractors, developers, retailers and wholesalers across the electrical supply chain.

Beyond supply, the company offers ongoing maintenance support for new and existing electrical systems, and a specialised lighting service ranging from decorative interior lighting through to stadium and street lighting installations. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, Megalight suits contractors and developers needing a single electrical wholesaler for cabling, lighting, switchgear and solar equipment on a project.

MentPro is an IT and capacity-management consultancy based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, working with medium and corporate clients at both strategic and operational levels. Its core services cover capacity optimisation and infrastructure right-sizing, helping organisations reallocate and repurpose IT resources so budget goes where it is actually needed rather than being spent on over-provisioned infrastructure.

The consultancy also offers availability management, ensuring IT services meet agreed service levels, along with ITSM consulting, process improvement and business continuity planning. Based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, MentPro suits medium and corporate organisations looking to mature their IT processes and get more consistent performance out of existing infrastructure rather than simply buying more capacity.

Established in 2004, MHS Contractors is a building renovation and maintenance contractor based in Sinoville, Pretoria, working across Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Johannesburg. The company offers painting, electrical, flooring and waterproofing services, with particular expertise in leaking roof repairs for residential and commercial properties, backed by two decades of hands-on renovation experience.

Its wider offering includes steelwork fabrication, paving, interior and exterior decorating, and property maintenance, alongside CCTV installation, solar power systems and other security solutions for homes and businesses. The team provides free quotations before starting a job, so clients know the scope of work upfront. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, MHS Contractors suits property owners who want renovation, waterproofing and basic security or solar installation handled by one contractor across a multi-city footprint.

Mirua Solar & Technology is a solar energy business based in Waverley, Pretoria, with more than five years in the industry. The company supplies solar products to installers and electricians, and also carries out its own photovoltaic and solar panel installation work for homeowners and businesses.

Beyond its Pretoria base, Mirua operates a branch in George and has a Rustenburg branch planned, giving it a presence beyond the immediate Pretoria market. Based in Bergtuin, Pretoria, the company suits both installers and electricians looking for a solar product supplier and homeowners or businesses wanting the installation handled directly by the same company.

ML Schoeman Attorneys is a law firm based in Montana Park, Pretoria, with more than 25 years of experience handling family, personal and general commercial legal matters. The firm offers both online and onsite consultations, giving clients the choice of meeting in person or handling a matter remotely.

Office hours run Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm and Friday from 8am to 3pm, with after-hours and weekend consultations available by appointment for clients who can't make a weekday slot. Based in Montana Park, Pretoria, ML Schoeman Attorneys suits individuals and families needing established legal advice on personal or commercial matters from a firm with decades of practice behind it.

MNK Movements and Projects Pty Ltd is a company incorporated in 2017 that combines furniture removal and moving services with building and construction work, based in the East Lynne area of Pretoria. Its moving side covers household and office relocations, handling items from furniture and appliances through to full-home moves.

Running moving services alongside a building and construction arm lets the company take on a broader range of client needs than a removals-only business, from relocating a home to doing structural or renovation work on it. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, MNK Movements and Projects suits clients needing either a moving company or a building contractor, or both, handled by a single business.

Montana Lisensies is a vehicle registration and licensing agency based in Montana, Pretoria, handling the administrative side of vehicle and business registration for private clients and company fleets. Its services cover vehicle licence disc renewals, new vehicle registrations, titleholder changes from bank to owner, and general change of ownership processing.

The agency also handles address changes, business registration certificates, number plates and holders, and books appointments for driver's licence renewals, keeping the process simple by confirming requirements upfront and updating clients as the administration is processed. Based in Montana, Pretoria, Montana Lisensies suits private vehicle owners and company fleet managers who want vehicle and licence administration handled by someone else rather than queuing at a licensing department themselves.

MoreSa Properties Pretoria is a family-run real estate agency based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, offering property sales and rental services across Gauteng. The agency guides clients from the initial market comparison through to the final settlement of a property, organising painters, builders and handymen along the way where needed to get a home ready for sale or move-in.

As part of a wider network with additional offices in Vanderbijlpark, Delmas, Grahamstown and Brits, the agency can draw on experience from several regional property markets rather than operating in isolation. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, MoreSa Properties suits buyers and sellers who want a hands-on, step-by-step service through their property transaction rather than a purely transactional listing service.

Morgan Advanced Materials operates a satellite office in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, as part of a global manufacturer of specialist products using carbon, advanced ceramics and composites. Founded in 1856, the group now runs 57 sites worldwide, developing materials engineered to solve complex problems across industries including thermal products, performance carbon and technical ceramics.

The group's materials are used where standard products can't cope with extreme heat, wear or electrical demands, supplying both the equipment itself and the engineering expertise behind it. Based in Amberfield, Centurion, the local office gives South African customers access to this global materials engineering capability without having to deal directly with an overseas supplier.

Motala Attorneys Pretoria North, established in August 2015, is a law firm based on Wonderboom Street in Pretoria North handling civil litigation, criminal defence, commercial and labour law, and the administration of estates and trusts. Its civil practice covers disputes between individuals or businesses, typically over money, taking matters from an initial claim through to an out-of-court settlement or a full court hearing.

The firm's approach is built around respecting client input at every stage of a matter, along with honesty and integrity in how a case is handled. Based in Wolmer, Pretoria North, Motala Attorneys suits individuals and businesses needing representation in civil, criminal, commercial or labour matters, or help administering an estate or trust.

Mulder Eiendomme is an estate agency based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, marketing residential properties such as houses and townhouses in the area. The agency's listings span around a dozen properties at any time across Pretoria's northern suburbs, giving it a smaller, more focused portfolio than a large national franchise.

Operating from Magalieskruin, the agency works directly with buyers and sellers in suburbs across Pretoria's north, including Sinoville, Montana and the surrounding areas. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, Mulder Eiendomme suits buyers and sellers looking for a locally focused agency with direct knowledge of Pretoria's northern residential suburbs rather than a large, impersonal franchise office.

Muller Developments is a motorsport-rooted automotive workshop based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, offering dyno tuning, race car setup and preparation, and aftermarket engine control work alongside specialised mechanical repairs and servicing. The workshop also installs water-methanol injection kits, a performance upgrade used to help engines run cooler and more efficiently under load.

Beyond its own workshop services, Muller Developments represents Intelligent Vehicle Management (IVM) vehicle-limiting technology, a system used to cap a vehicle's performance for specific operational or insurance requirements. Based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, the workshop suits motorsport enthusiasts and owners of performance vehicles needing specialist tuning and mechanical work that a general workshop wouldn't normally offer.

Multiplex Technologies is a software development company based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, operating since 2013. The company provides custom software solutions, corporate identity design and web and email hosting for small and medium-sized organisations, both profit and non-profit.

Its web applications are built to be mobile responsive across different screen sizes, with an emphasis on clean, maintainable code and a strong user experience. Alongside custom software, the company also offers domain registration and mobile app development for clients wanting an app to complement their website. Based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, Multiplex Technologies suits small and medium organisations needing custom software, branding and hosting handled by one technical team.

My Tech African Group is a digital services company founded in 2015, offering web design, cybersecurity, digital marketing and brand design services to businesses across Africa. Its websites are built on WordPress, aiming to get a professional site live within hours rather than weeks, and its cybersecurity offering is delivered through a strategic partnership with Sophos.

On the digital marketing side, the company builds custom solutions using technologies ranging from JavaScript to Python, and its brand development service includes helping clients improve their credit profile to get vehicle finance approved through South Africa's four major banks. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, My Tech African Group suits businesses wanting website, security, marketing and branding support from a single digital services provider.

Nad Supplies is a Rosslyn-based manufacturer and supplier of packaging materials, producing corrugated boxes, ISPM15-certified wooden pallets and crates, and cardboard crates for bulk shipping. The company also supplies slip sheets, corrugated sheets used as protective interlayers, and strapping, able to supply in bulk and to a customer's own specification rather than only off a standard size chart.

Its packaging is manufactured in Rosslyn and delivered nationwide, serving both local companies and export clients who need compliant, durable industrial packaging for storage, handling and transport. The cardboard crates are built for secure bulk shipping on pallets, streamlining warehouse handling and export logistics for industrial clients. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, Nad Supplies suits businesses across manufacturing, logistics and export that need corrugated and pallet-based packaging produced locally rather than imported.

National Medical Supplies is a medical equipment supplier founded in 2002 and based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria West. The business specialises in vision healthcare, women's healthcare, and sterilisation and infection control products, including ophthalmic surgical instruments, supplying South Africa's healthcare sector rather than selling directly to the public.

As a specialist supplier rather than a general medical wholesaler, National Medical Supplies focuses on a defined set of product categories, letting it build deeper expertise in those specific areas of healthcare equipment. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm. Based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria West, the business suits hospitals, clinics and healthcare practitioners sourcing ophthalmic, women's health or infection control equipment from a dedicated specialist supplier.

New Dawn Property Group is an estate agency based in Heuwelsig, Centurion, anchored by the Mabe Property Group. The agency offers residential property sales and rentals, with listings spanning Pretoria, Gauteng and other South African provinces rather than being limited to a single city.

Its online property listings cover houses, townhouses, apartments and vacant land across a range of price points and locations, and the agency offers email alerts so buyers can be notified as matching properties come onto the market. Based in Heuwelsig Estate, Centurion, New Dawn Property Group suits buyers and sellers who want an agency with reach beyond a single suburb or city, backed by the wider Mabe Property Group network.

NF Laboratories is a personal care products manufacturer based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, producing customisable bulk bases for body lotions, shower gels, hair care and skincare products. Businesses in the personal care industry can take these bases and tailor them to their own brand rather than developing a formulation from scratch.

Its product categories include body care such as lotions, creams, body butters and scrubs, bath and shower products including shower gels and bubble baths, hair care ranges such as shampoo and conditioner, and skincare items such as facial washes and moisturisers. The company also sources packaging such as perfume bottles, pumps and sprayers in bulk. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, NF Laboratories suits personal care brands and distributors needing flexible, bulk-manufactured product bases rather than building their own production line.

Northern Vinyl Supplies has served the sign-making industry in Pretoria North for over 20 years, stocking a wide range of vinyls in different tack strengths along with cut-to-size plexiglass and sign-printing equipment. The business supplies Mimaki large-format printers and inks from Mimaki and Sun Chemical, and offers Avery Dennison vinyl films and wrapping solutions for applications from automotive restyling to retail signage and architectural design.

Through its Evergreen Coatings division, the company has also produced printing ink and coatings in South Africa for more than three decades, and its own signage services cover banner welding, light boxes, and custom signs including vinyl banners and chromadek. It is open Tuesdays to Fridays from 8am to 5pm, closed Mondays and weekends. Based in Boekenhoutskloof, Pretoria North, Northern Vinyl Supplies suits sign makers and businesses needing vinyl, printing equipment and custom signage from an established local supplier.

Novus BEE Solutions provides Black Economic Empowerment consulting from its offices at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Pretoria. The practice helps organisations understand and manage the impact of BEE on their business, treating it as a strategic opportunity rather than only a compliance requirement.

Its services cover BEE strategy development, skills development, supplier and enterprise development, and BEE training, along with third-party software solutions for ongoing BEE management. Novus works with organisations at any stage of their BEE journey, from initial strategy development through to element-specific initiatives and general consultation. Based in Irene, Pretoria, Novus BEE Solutions suits businesses needing a dedicated BEE partner to manage compliance while also building it into their broader strategy.

NuHuman Transformation Gym is a holistic health and weight-loss transformation gym based in Shere Lifestyle Centre, Pretoria, part of a wider NuHuman network of locations. The gym combines training, nutrition coaching, stress management and scientific health testing into a single transformation programme, rather than offering gym access alone.

The brand markets itself as South Africa's number one weight-loss and transformation gym, and this branch has guided hundreds of clients through a transformation to date. It is open Monday to Friday from 5am to 12pm and again from 3pm to 7pm, closed on weekends. Based in Shere, Pretoria, NuHuman Transformation Gym suits people looking for a structured, coached weight-loss programme rather than a standard unsupervised gym membership.

NwaMzamani Properties is a 100% Black-owned and 100% female-owned residential real estate agency based in Amandasig, Akasia, registered with the CIPC, the NHBRC and the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority. The agency helps clients buy, sell and rent homes, with a focus on Amandasig and neighbouring areas such as Chantelle and Clarina.

Beyond sales and rentals, the agency manages rental properties on behalf of landlords, drawing on a pool of skilled tradespeople covering plumbing, building maintenance and carpentry, and also prepares sold properties for a new owner's move-in through painting, garden preparation and house cleaning. Based in Amandasig, Akasia, NwaMzamani Properties suits landlords, buyers and sellers in the northern Pretoria suburbs looking for an agency that also handles the practical side of a move.

Oasis Water's Karenpark branch, at Karenpark Crossing on the corner of Daffodil and Heinrich Avenue, is a water purification and retail outlet of the national Oasis Water chain. The branch sells reverse-osmosis purified water refills and bottled water, alongside juices, plain and flavoured sparkling water, and ice.

As one of the branches within a chain of more than 360 Oasis Water outlets across South Africa, the Karenpark store benefits from the group's established reverse-osmosis purification process while operating as a local, walk-in retail point. Based in Karenpark, Pretoria, this branch suits households and businesses in the area wanting an affordable, eco-friendly alternative to bottled water bought from a supermarket.

Oasis Water's Montana branch on Braam Pretorius Street purifies water to a Total Dissolved Solids count of under 20, well below the 150-plus TDS typical of municipal tap water in the area. As part of the national Oasis Water chain of more than 360 outlets, the branch sells reverse-osmosis purified water refills and bottled water along with related retail products.

The lower TDS reading means the water has fewer dissolved minerals and impurities than standard tap water, which is the main reason customers choose a refill over municipal supply. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, this Oasis Water branch suits households and businesses in the Montana area wanting a convenient, locally based purified water refill point.

Olu-K Properties is a Waverley-based estate agency led by a buy-to-let specialist, property coach and advisor, offering residential property valuations alongside its sales and rental work. The agency reviews and renews lease agreements for landlords, handling the paperwork side of keeping a rental tenancy legally up to date.

Its rental management service also covers incoming, interim and outgoing property inspections, documenting a rental property's condition at the start, during and end of a tenancy to protect both landlord and tenant. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, Olu-K Properties suits landlords who want ongoing lease and inspection management alongside the usual buying, selling and letting services of an estate agency.

Orchards Graduate School is a 100% Black-owned and managed training institution based in The Orchards, Pretoria, offering distance-based learning, part-time programmes and short courses. Its course offering includes Early Childhood Development, Public Administration and Management Skills, aimed at aligning individual and organisational training strategies with broader business goals.

The school is accredited through ETDP SETA, Services SETA, LGSETA, PSETA and QCTO, and has seen 157 learners graduate in ECD Level 4 and a National Diploma to date. It also runs an online learning option, letting students based outside Pretoria study without relocating. Based in The Orchards, Pretoria, Orchards Graduate School suits individuals and organisations across South Africa seeking accredited distance and part-time training rather than only in-person classes.

ORI Professionals is a business advisory and consulting firm in Eco Park, Centurion, offering accounting, taxation, financial advisory and financial modelling alongside investment advisory, data analytics and statistical analysis, and quantitative and qualitative research. Its practice also covers facilitation and mediation, capacity building and change management, and human resources management, giving it a broader advisory base than a single-discipline accounting or consulting firm.

Founded in 2015 and run as a small, privately held practice, ORI Professionals works with organisations of various sizes and industries on client advisory projects and ongoing client relationship management. Based at 340 Witch Hazel Avenue in Eco Park, Centurion, the firm suits organisations needing combined financial, advisory, research or HR support from one consultancy rather than several separate specialists.

Orion Airconditioning is an HVAC company based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, handling the supply, installation, service, maintenance and repair of air conditioners across a range of brands. The business works with both residential and commercial clients, covering everything from a single household unit to larger commercial air conditioning systems.

Serving the Pretoria East area, Orion Airconditioning takes on both new installations and the ongoing servicing and repair work that keeps existing systems running efficiently. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, the business suits homeowners and businesses across Pretoria East needing one HVAC contractor for installation, maintenance and repairs rather than separate suppliers for each brand of unit.

Overkruin Uitrusters has specialised in school uniforms, sportswear and workwear since 1980, with this store on Emily Hobhouse Avenue being one of three branches the retailer operates across the greater Pretoria North area. The business fits and supplies uniforms for local schools alongside general sportswear and workwear for adults and children.

Having three branches across Pretoria North lets the retailer serve several school communities in the area rather than operating from a single, harder-to-reach location. Based in Florauna, Pretoria North, Overkruin Uitrusters suits parents needing school uniforms as well as customers looking for sportswear or workwear from a long-established local retailer.

Pam Golding Properties Centurion is an estate agency office serving the Centurion area, including Centurion Golf Estate, under the long-established Pam Golding Properties brand. The office offers property sales and rentals spanning new developments, sectional titles, smallholdings and golf estates, covering a wide range of property types rather than one niche.

As part of a real estate group with more than 300 offices and a presence across Southern Africa, the Centurion office can draw on a national referral network and shared marketing resources alongside its local knowledge of the Centurion property market. Based at the corner of Gerhard Street and Jean Avenue in Highlands, Centurion, the office suits buyers and sellers across Centurion Golf Estate and the wider Centurion area looking for an established national agency with local representation.

PAN Hospitality, established in 1998 and based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, develops a hospitality property management software system built to consolidate a hotel's management needs into a single platform. The system covers reservations and front-of-house operations, stock and point-of-sale, accounting and payroll, room management, and debtors and creditors.

Its reservation software is built to help property managers maximise availability and manage release dates as part of a wider yield-management strategy, with the broader platform offering real-time updating of ledger balances and account reconciliations. The system is designed to be customised to suit a specific property's needs rather than applied as a rigid, one-size package. Based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, PAN Hospitality suits hotels and other hospitality businesses wanting their reservations, stock, accounting and room management handled through one integrated system.

Panarottis Montana is a branch of the family-style Italian restaurant chain trading from inside Kolonnade Shopping Centre in Montana, Pretoria. The restaurant serves pizzas and pastas alongside a dedicated kids' menu, making it a practical option for family groups rather than only couples or individual diners.

Trading from within Kolonnade Shopping Centre gives the restaurant the convenience of mall parking and nearby shopping for families combining a meal with other errands. It is open daily from 8am to 10pm. Based in Montana, Pretoria, Panarottis Montana suits families and groups looking for a casual, reliable Italian meal with a children's option on the menu.

Pankop Security is a Black-owned security systems supplier and installer established in 2008, operating from Pretoria North as part of the wider Pankop Group. The company is registered with FSIB, PSIRA, SABS and SAQCC, and provides armed guarding, alarm system installation and maintenance, CCTV installation, access control and armed response services.

Its access control offering includes biometric, tag and telephone-based systems for homes and offices, alongside electronic gate and garage door automation, PA systems for office communication, and school intercom and bell systems for educational clients. The company also runs 24-hour alarm and CCTV monitoring from its own control room. Based in The Orchards, Pretoria North, Pankop Security suits homes, offices and schools needing a single supplier for security systems, monitoring and automation.

Pegasus South Africa is an accounting, tax and wealth management firm with offices in Pretoria and Paarl, founded in 2008. The firm works with businesses and high-net-worth individuals on assurance and valuations, tax advisory, accounting, consulting and advisory, wealth management, and company secretarial services.

Its approach centres on building long-term relationships with clients rather than handling once-off transactions, combining technology with personalised service to help clients make informed financial decisions today while planning for the future. Based at the Podium at Menlyn in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Pegasus South Africa suits businesses and individuals looking to build sustainable financial structures and long-term financial security through an established accounting and wealth management practice.

Pharm4Game is a specialist supplier based in Queenswood, Pretoria, offering medicines and health products for wildlife as well as small and large domestic animals. The business serves farmers, game reserve operators and pet owners needing animal health products rather than general human pharmacy items.

Covering both wildlife and domestic animal health in one business lets customers with mixed needs, such as a smallholding with both livestock and pets, source products from a single specialist supplier. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm. Based in Queenswood, Pretoria, Pharm4Game suits farmers, game operators and pet owners across the region needing animal medicines and health products from a dedicated supplier.
